messages:
maya: Heads up — planning to cut release/1.13 tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Please confirm outstanding backports and any must-have cherry-picks.
jonathan: I can create the branch after the 8:30 AM merge window. Does the team want the version bump included in the branch or as a follow-up PR?
maya: bump in branch is fine. also reminder: cutoff for non-critical changes = today EOD PT.
sara: changelog bot only picks PRs labelled `changelog/yes`. If folks add that label now it will be included. Also we should add a short note for breaking changes.
luis: Quick backport rules reminder: bugfixes, docs, and perf fixes only. No feature backports unless product signs off. Exceptions require a note in the PR and a :thumbsup: from an eng lead.
jonathan: For cherry-picks, please open PRs targeting `release/1.13` and use branch name format `cherry/1234-brief-desc`. Add `backport-request` label. I'll add a PR template snippet for backports.
maya: Adding one exception: perf fix in #4321 is important for latency SLAs — @luis can you review the backport?
luis: I can take #4321. I'll try to get the backport PR up this afternoon.
ci-bot: ci: master is green except flaky `test-token-cache` on ubuntu-20.04. Deploy queue may block if we don't address flakes.
sara: Noted — if tests stay flaky we'll gate merge window. Also I'll prepare the release note skeleton once the branch is created.
jonathan: Plan: I'll cut `release/1.13` at 08:40 PDT, push the initial branch, and open the version-bump PR. Command I'll run:
```
# create branch from master
git fetch origin && git checkout -b release/1.13 origin/master
./scripts/bump_version.sh 1.13.0
git commit -am "chore: release/1.13 initial bump"
git push origin release/1.13
```
jonathan: After I push I'll paste the branch link here so people can open cherry-picks against it.
maya: thanks. once branch is up i'll tag release owners and ping QA for quick smoke. :rocket:
sara: reminder to add `changelog/yes` and a one-line summary in PR body. I will collate entries.
jonathan: branch pushed: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/compare/release/1.13 <- open your cherry-picks against this.
maya: awesome, thanks. @everyone please post any last minute MUST-HAVES by 07:30 PDT so we can triage before cut.
luis: will do. ping me on the PR for #4321.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for release/1.13 once we merge the version bump PR.
maya: closing loop — I'll run the final checklist 30m before cut and post status here.
